figs.name: mass-flow-controller-closed-loop-control-flowchart
figs.alt: how does mass flow controller work flowchart with setpoint, sensor, PID and valve
figs.caption: Diagram by Instrumentation Blog showing the MFC closed loop: the sensor measures mass flow, the PID compares it with the setpoint and the valve corrects the error.
figs.after_h2: How a Mass Flow Controller Works
figs.svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 560" width="100%" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif">
<title>Mass flow controller closed loop control flowchart</title>
<rect width="800" height="560" fill="#ffffff"/>
<defs><marker id="ah" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path d="M0 0L10 5L0 10z" fill="#1a2b4a"/></marker></defs>
<text x="400.0" y="34" font-size="24" fill="#065f46" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Mass Flow Controller Control Loop</text>
<rect x="250" y="58" width="300" height="54" rx="10" fill="#ecfdf5" stroke="#059669" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="400.0" y="79.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Setpoint entered</text>
<text x="400.0" y="102.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">in sccm or slm</text>
<line x1="400" y1="112" x2="400" y2="132" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="230" y="132" width="340" height="54" rx="10" fill="#ecfdf5" stroke="#059669" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="400.0" y="153.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Sensor measures</text>
<text x="400.0" y="176.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">actual mass flow</text>
<line x1="400" y1="186" x2="400" y2="206" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<polygon points="400,207.0 545.0,256 400,305.0 255.0,256" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#059669" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="400" y="251.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Flow equal to</text>
<text x="400" y="272.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">setpoint?</text>
<line x1="545" y1="256" x2="590" y2="256" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="566" y="246" font-size="17" fill="#16a34a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Yes</text>
<rect x="590" y="226" width="180" height="60" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#059669" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="680.0" y="250.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Hold valve</text>
<text x="680.0" y="273.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">position</text>
<line x1="400" y1="305" x2="400" y2="330" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="418" y="324" font-size="17" fill="#dc2626" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">No</text>
<rect x="200" y="330" width="400" height="60" rx="10" fill="#fff7e6" stroke="#059669" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="400.0" y="354.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">High: valve closes slightly</text>
<text x="400.0" y="377.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Low: valve opens slightly</text>
<polyline points="200,360 120,360 120,159 228,159" fill="none" stroke="#059669" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<polyline points="680,286 680,420 120,420 120,362" fill="none" stroke="#059669" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-dasharray="6 5"/>
<text x="400" y="412" font-size="17" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">loop repeats continuously</text>
<rect x="40" y="446" width="720" height="96" rx="12" fill="#ecfdf5" stroke="#059669" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="400" y="476" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Example: upstream pressure rises, a needle valve passes more gas,</text>
<text x="400" y="502" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">but the MFC sees the higher flow and closes its valve slightly.</text>
<text x="400" y="528" font-size="17" fill="#065f46" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Settling to 98% of setpoint takes about 1 to 3 s.</text>
</svg>
